summary: SFL Corporation filed a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026 announcing it agreed to sell four 2014- and 2015-built LR2 product tankers and three 2019-built Suezmax tankers to Trafigura, their current time charterer. The existing charters terminate on vessel delivery, scheduled across Q4 2026 and Q1 2027. Per-vessel prices were confidential; after profit-share and debt repayment, net cash proceeds are estimated near $275 million, with an approximately $175 million aggregate book gain. The fleet was acquired in 2021-2022. Proceeds are earmarked for accretive reinvestment; watch closing execution and redeployment yield.
